headline: Gold steady today at ₹12,841 per gram (24K); silver down over the week
summary: Gold's move today is tiny: 24K rose just ₹1 per gram (0.01%) from yesterday's ₹12,840, and 22K rose ₹1 as well. Over the last 7 days 24K is up 2.66% (₹333), but across the 34 days in our history it is down 10.05%, after peaking at ₹14,602 on 5 November and touching a low of ₹12,328 on 25 November. Silver is up only ₹100 per kg (0.06%) today to ₹1,70,100, is down 2.8% over the last 7 days, and is down 22.68% since 26 October, when it was ₹2,20,000. Possible drivers include movements in the US dollar, the rupee and international spot prices, which were roughly flat in the same window.
outlook: With today's move so small, there is no strong reason to rush; buyers planning a purchase may compare making charges and GST across jewellers, and wait only if their timing is flexible.
